title: ASUS and ROG Grand Tech Fair 2026 brings holiday promos from the no. 1 consumer laptop and PC brand in the Philippines
summary: ASUS and Republic of Gamers (ROG) officially launch the ASUS and ROG Grand Tech Fair 2026, bringing the season’s biggest tech deals across the country. From November 9, 2026, to January 17,…

blocks.text: ASUS and Republic of Gamers (ROG) officially launch the ASUS and ROG Grand Tech Fair 2026, bringing the season’s biggest tech deals across the country. From November 9, 2026, to January 17, 2027, buyers can join the nationwide holiday raffle, claim exclusive freebies with eligible purchases, and score instant GCash rebates and exclusive gifts at weekend Mall Caravans.

This season, there is a device for every need. The ProArt series empowers creative professionals, while Zenbook combines style and performance for life on-the-go. The Vivobook lineup delivers everyday productivity with long-lasting battery life, while ROG and TUF Gaming cater to power users and gaming enthusiasts with high-performance machines. Rounding out the lineup are ASUS All-in-One (AiO) PCs, designed for convenient home and office productivity.

ASUS and ROG continue to offer lasting value beyond holiday deals by providing trusted quality and protection with every purchase through the ASUS No. 1 Quality and Service Package. This package includes up to 3 years of local and international warranty coverage – honored across more than 130 local service centers and drop-off points and supported in over 90 countries worldwide –along with 1-year Local Accidental Damage Protection, up to 6x free device cleanings and a 14-day return policy.

Make the most of the holiday season with the chance to win one of the 12 incredible raffle prizes, exclusive bundles with eligible purchases, and special mall-exclusive perks – including instant GCash rebates and mystery gifts. Visit participating ASUS and ROG stores and authorizes resellers from November 9, 2026, to January 17, 2027, and celebrate the holidays with the No. 1 Consumer PC Brand in the Philippines! For the complete promo details, visit the ASUS and ROG Grand Tech Fair 2026 website: https://ph.asus.click/grandtechfair2026
WIN INCREDIBLE PRIZES IN THE 12 GIFTS OF ASUS NATIONWIDE RAFFLE

Purchases from November 9, 2026 to January 17, 2027 of eligible consumer laptops, gaming laptops, select desktops, and All-in-One (AiO) PCs automatically qualify for an entry into the 12 Gifts of ASUS Nationwide Raffle upon online product registration until 11:59PM on January 17, 2027. Each unique device serial number entitles the customer to one registration and one raffle entry, giving buyers nationwide the chance to win a share of the PHP 180,000+ prize pool when purchasing through official ASUS and ROG Exclusive Stores and authorized resellers.

items: Minor Draw (December 16, 2026): Six winners will take home gear including the ROG Falchion Ace 75 HE Gaming Keyboard (worth PHP 12,390), JBL Charge 6 Portable Speaker (worth PHP 10,999), and Midea TF Bladeless Fan (worth PHP 8,995).

Major Draw (January 25, 2027): Six major winners will receive top-tier prizes including the ROG Xbox Ally (worth PHP 41,995), DJI Osmo Pocket 3 Action Camera (worth PHP 20,600), Fujifilm Instax Mini Evo Instant Camera (worth PHP 13,000), and the exclusive ROG Slash Luggage Edition 20 (worth PHP 15,995).

blocks.text: IDC NAMES ASUS NO. 1 CONSUMER LAPTOP AND PC BRAND IN THE PHILIPPINES

ASUS has secured the title of No. 1 Consumer Laptop Brand in the Philippines, according to the IDC Quarterly Personal Computing Device Tracker for Q3 2026. The brand held a 32.6% share of the consumer laptop market in Q3, making it the No. 1 brand in the category, and recorded a remarkable 111.4% increase in laptop shipments from Q2 to Q3 this year, reflecting strong market momentum and growing consumer demand. ASUS’s leadership extends beyond laptops. It also holds the No. 1 position in the overall consumer and gaming PC categories in the country, further reinforcing its standing as the leading computing brand in the Philippines.
